title: mirabilis rotundifolia
intro: Mirabilis rotundifolia, commonly known as Indian cucumber or round-leaved moonseed, is a perennial plant species in the Nyctaginaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide health benefits, such as aiding in the treatment of fever, inflammation, and skin conditions, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis rotundifolia are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant activity, and show potential as an antiviral agent. The bioactive constituents of Mirabilis rotundifolia include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
